jobs.occupation: Development Engineer (m/w/d) Aerospace (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities

- You work on the development and production of our products and are responsible for manufacturing prototypes and products
- You develop components and manufacturing processes with a focus on lightweight solutions for aerospace applications
- You participate in a fast and iterative development process, contributing your own ideas and concepts to our products
- You are responsible for scaling and industrializing manufacturing processes
- You support the team as a point of contact for process and material topics in the design of components, fixtures, and molding tools

Your profile

- You have a degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, manufacturing technology, or a related field
- You have some initial professional experience in manufacturing processes or lightweight construction
- Your excellent teamwork skills and willingness to collaborate with other teams set you apart
- You have strong manual skills and a practical, solution-oriented approach to work
- You are creative, curious, and passionate about innovative lightweight solutions
- You possess excellent English and German language skills

What we offer

- Extensive decision-making freedom and short decision-making paths
- Flexible working hours and remote work options by arrangement
- Shared lunch breaks with varied and freshly prepared daily meals
- Choose one of our three perks: Germany Ticket, Egym Wellpass, or Give Card
- Expand your knowledge by working with inspiring people and exciting projects in the high-tech aerospace sector
- Exciting development opportunities in a dynamically growing company
- Casual startup atmosphere, agile team, and regular team events
- After work, unwind on our spacious rooftop terrace with views of the Alps to end your day on a high note

ID: 55051

What is your role and surroundings?

Our Faurecia Mercedes-Benz Sales Unit is looking for you as a VIE Sales Engineer m/f for our Customer’s Office in Böblingen (Stuttgart area), Germany.

The VIE Sales Engineer is working with, and learning from the Program Sales Lead MBAG within Faurecia Automotive Seating. He/she reports to the Sales Manager and will work on different commercial management objectives during the period of employment.

The VIE will start with an orientation phase supporting the Sales Department. After sales fundamentals on-boarding is complete, based on skill and interest- the candidate will manage specific Sales tasks in his/her own responsibility – with close support of his/her N+1.

An intercultural background, including German language and cultural proximity would be a plus to support the Program Team in exchange and alignment with our central functions. On top we support your development and deep understanding of German culture and language during the mission. With this combination, we will create an opportunity for a further career path potentially within Faurecia. Pending on interest and development of the candidate, Faurecia tries an extension of the 1st mission by additional 12 month on-site at our Böblingen Customer’s Office with different Sales Experiences in either another project or scope in order to ensure full development of a potential Sales Engineer within Faurecia.

What will be your main missions?

- In coordination with the Sales Manager and the sales engineers, preparation of internal documentation, presentations as well as conducting negotiations with the Customer (MBAG)
- Support in reporting and monitoring
- Ensure permanent contact with various internal and external departments incl. our Plants and Core Team colleagues, resilient and strongly driven to face complexity
- Coordinate the implementation of technical and commercial offers
- Ensure that the evolution of permanent parts pricing in line with the Divisions budget
- Support in budget & volume planning

The mission will last 12 months (with preferable option to extend to 24 months).

What you need to join us?

- Master’s degree in Engineering and/or Economics. - Commercial negotiation & orientation is a plus
- Passion for automotive à commercials & negotiation as a wished career path
- English language is mandatory as you will be speaking with people from all over the world.
- Microsoft® Excel® acumen

Who are we looking for?

- International mindset and strong analytical skills
- Results oriented and very driven, with strong written and oral communications skills
- A proactive approach to work and optimist energy;
- Good interpersonal skills.

What will this role offer you?

- You will work within an international Sales team full of energy;
- You will work on challenges
- You will find a strong emphasis on talent development and abundant opportunities for growth;
- You will grow professionally, polyvalence and autonomy will be part of your daily work;
- A powerful VIE community spirit within Forvians.

Job ID: req1077

General Summary

Reporting to the Director, Sales DACH, the position will work closely with the Internal Sales and Technical Sales teams to drive the overall Company Business Strategy. Develops and executes Sales Business Plans and Strategies to maximize revenue growth, increase market share, and position the company as a strategic supplier to Key customers within Region.

Responsibilities

- Manages customer activities within the defined region, works in conjunction with the Technical & Product
- Solutions Manager and Internal Sales Representatives to introduce the Rochester Electronics product to
- customers and to increase the customer portfolio per the agreed business development plan.
- Identifies target customers, builds relationships, and develops strategies utilizing all available resources to grow the account base within the specified region.
- Lead generation, qualifying business opportunities, and business presentations.
- Responsible for accurate and timely forecasting of new business opportunities and revenue for the region
- Ensuring CRM is utilized and maintained daily.
- Provides effective communication and service to the customer base and effectively navigates internally to priorities on active business opportunities.
- Travel within the assigned region will be expected at min. 50%

Other Duties & Responsibilities

- Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

- BA or BS Degree in Electronics related subjects would be advantage
- Proven business development, sales & management experience in the electronic component/ semiconductor industry
- Experience developing a large territory while working from a virtual office
- Excellent oral and written communication skills and an ability to influence others internally and externally
- Being fluent in German and English language is essential; any additional languages would be advantageous
- Strong Relationship-building skills both internally and externally and able to navigate and effectively manage business partners & suppliers successfully
- Proven background in developing relationships with key decision-makers and influencers, including experience in closing complex deals with customers & partners
- Flexibility and multi-tasking, ability to undertake several tasks at once and manage them efficiently
- Ability to problem solve by identifying the root cause and realizing/implementing solutions
- Ability to maintain focus with little or no supervision
- Passionate about business and willing to go the extra mile
- Positive attitude with the ability to engage and learn quickly

Other Working Conditions/Physical Demands

- Must hold a full current driving license
- Must be able and willing to travel

Purpose of your Job

As part of our Finance team, the Financial Accountant plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and efficiency of our financial operations. The position involves maintaining proper accounting records, monitoring payments, and supporting the preparation of financial statements. Working closely with colleagues and external partners, the role contributes to process optimization and supports audits. Professional experience in financial accounting is essential to ensuring financial integrity and supporting the company’s sustainable growth.

Please note: This is a temporary position offered on a fixed-term basis for 12 - 24 months.

Your Responsibility

- Independent accounting of general and subsidiary ledgers.
- Monitoring, reconciling, and clarifying accounts, including the processing of open items.
- Handling bank transactions and managing petty cash.
- Reviewing and posting operating and ancillary cost statements.
- Close collaboration with insurance providers and financial partners.
- Supporting the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB).
- Assisting during internal and external audits, including tax audits.
- Actively contributing to the further development and digitalization of financial processes.

What you need to succeed

- Completed vocational training in accounting/finance or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field
- 2+ years of experience in financial accounting (GL, AP, or AR)
- Hands-on experience with month-end and year-end closing (HGB)
- Confident in account reconciliations, accruals, and journal entries
- Practical experience with accounting software (e.g., DATEV) and Excel (pivot tables, lookups)
- German (C1) and English (B2), written and spoken
- Understanding of VAT regulations (Germany/EU)
- Strong numerical and analytical skills with high attention to detail
- Ability to meet deadlines and work independently in a structured way
- Team-oriented with clear and professional communication skills

Ipsos Ipsos is one of the world's largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. Ipsos Healthcare is the world's leading provider of quantitative and qualitative market research studies in the pharmaceutical and medical technology sectors. The focus is on doctors, medical professionals, and, above all, patients. Our range of solutions is very diverse and covers traditional primary market research as well as scientific Real-World Evidence studies. In collaboration with our national and international clients, we conduct studies along the entire lifecycle of a healthcare product, from early demand and quality-of-life studies to projects for the preparation and accompaniment of product launches (including success measurements) and studies that help already launched products or approved preparations achieve greater success. We are looking for a Project Executive (f/m/d) for our Healthcare team at one of our locations in Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Nuremberg or Munich. Your role You support the planning, coordination, and delivery of healthcare market research and innovation projects from proposal stage through to execution. You work closely with project managers, insights teams, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to quality standards. You coordinate external suppliers and partners, tracking project progress and supporting the management of timelines, deliverables, and documentation. You maintain project documentation and ensure that project records, specifications, and study materials are complete, accurate, and up to date. You support data management activities, including data validation, quality control, and preparation of deliverables using tools such as Excel and other reporting platforms. You contribute to testing activities for surveys, research platforms, and project workflows, helping to identify issues and support process improvements and automation efforts. You assist in monitoring project risks, resolving operational challenges, and ensuring smooth collaboration across internal and external teams. You act as a reliable point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders, providing regular status updates and ensuring transparency throughout the project lifecycle. You contribute to the continuous improvement of project management processes, tools, and ways of working, including the use of AI and automation solutions. You collaborate with colleagues across Ipsos Germany and the international Healthcare network to support successful project delivery. Your profile You hold a university degree, preferably in business administration (focus on marketing/market research), social sciences, psychology, communication science, health science/public health, or a comparable field. You have initial professional experience in project management, market research, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, medical technology, or a related field through internships, working student positions, or early-career employment. You have a strong interest in project coordination, operational excellence, and delivering high-quality client work. You possess strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to managing multiple tasks and deadlines. You are comfortable working with data and have advanced Excel skills; experience with SPSS, Power BI, or Python skills are a plus. You have an interest in data management, process optimization, testing, and automation. You demonstrate strong communication and stakeholder management skills and enjoy collaborating with suppliers, clients, and cross-functional teams. You are fluent in English; German language skills are a plus. You are proactive, team-oriented, and motivated to learn and grow in an international healthcare research environment. Experience working with AI-based solutions, survey platforms, reporting tools, or research technologies is a plus. What we offer At Ipsos, you can expect an international and innovative working environment. We serve renowned clients across almost all major industries and work on exciting projects worldwide! You can look forward to: Hybrid work Flexible working hours Workation in European countries Ipsos Corporate Benefits Subsidy for the Germany public transport ticket (Deutschlandticket) Job rotation opportunities Development & learning culture International collaboration Events & local community Diversity & inclusion initiatives Corporate social responsibility programs Modern workplace Interested? Apply now! We look forward to receiving your application (CV, certificates, and optional a short cover letter) including your earliest possible start date and salary expectations. Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK
We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

Collaborate in a dynamic, diverse, and innovation-driven environment, where your experience and leadership will be valued.

- 
Design, set up, maintain, and continually enhance our AWS cloud resources using infrastructure-as-code and support the roll-out of new payment products and services from infrastructure perspective.

- 
Take ownership of deployments during releases and ensuring the sound functioning of CI/CD pipelines.

- 
Further develop our data pipeline with integrations to various systems.

- 
Leverage your Datadog expertise to enhance and maintain platform reliability and monitoring.

- 
Drive IT Operations during the roll-out of existing products to new markets and use-cases.

- 
Collaborate with Mercedes-Benz Group IT specialists and external providers to co-create innovative solutions.

- 
Play a key role in ensuring the operational excellence of our global payment platform.

- 
Ensure compliance of all operational products with Mercedes policies and relevant external laws and regulations.

Qualifikationen WHAT WE EXPECT

A burning passion for IT, along with an open-minded and highly motivated attitude.

- 
Successful completion of relevant studies in Computer Science or equivalent work experience.

- 
Strong solution-oriented, problem-solving and analytical skills.

- 
Proficiency in cloud service architecture best practices and experience in writing infrastructure-as-code.

- 
Skilled at Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm and experience with software programming (e.g. Java), Git SCM, and proficiency in the Atlassian Toolchain.

- 
Datadog hands-on experience, and deep understanding of features and capabilities.

- 
Experience with platform reliability best practices, set up of monitors, automated alerts and on-call service.

- 
Knowledge of IT security best practice and common standards.

- Fluent business English skills.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Modern and dynamic work environment
- Flexible and mobile working
- Attractive fitness offer
- Numerous employee discounts
- Excellent infrastructure

Your MissionWe are looking for an Account Executive (f/m/d) to join us on 1 December 2026 and help further establish MakerVerse as a leading platform for on-demand manufacturing in Germany.
In this role, you will bring companies on board with our AI-powered platform and demonstrate the value of solutions such as additive manufacturing, CNC machining, and injection molding. You will work closely with our Customer Acquisition Managers (CAMs), take over qualified leads, and guide them from the specific customer request through the proposal and negotiation stages to a successful close. Along the way, you will build long-term, trusted customer relationships.
This position is ideal for sales-driven professionals who enjoy developing new business opportunities, building lasting customer relationships, actively driving revenue, and taking ownership in a dynamic environment.
You will work remotely from anywhere in Germany. During the third week of each month, you will work with the team at our Berlin office from Tuesday to Thursday. We cover your travel and accommodation expenses. These regular team meetings provide valuable opportunities for in-person collaboration, exchanging ideas, and team activities.

Your Impact
• Sales Responsibility: You will take on qualified sales opportunities and guide customers from their initial requirements through to a confirmed order. You will prioritize your sales opportunities, agree on clear next steps, and keep your pipeline reliably up to date.
• Solution-Oriented Consulting: You will develop and present tailored, technically focused proposals that address our customers’ needs across various manufacturing technologies.
• Customer Relationship Management: You will build and maintain strong customer relationships by serving as a trusted point of contact throughout the entire project lifecycle.
• Customer Development: You will identify opportunities to expand existing customer relationships and generate follow-up orders.
• Sales Collaboration: You will work closely with our Customer Acquisition Managers (CAMs) to successfully convert pipeline opportunities into revenue.
• Interdisciplinary Collaboration: You will collaborate with internal teams to ensure the smooth implementation of customer projects, resolve challenges, and identify new business opportunities.

Your DNA
• Closing skills: Ideally, you have two to four years of experience in B2B sales with a proven track record.
• Consultative mindset: You enjoy understanding your customers’ challenges and developing tailored solutions, rather than focusing solely on high outreach volumes.
• Communication skills: You have strong presentation and negotiation skills.
• CRM experience: You are confident in using CRM systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar tools to manage pipelines and create forecasts.
• Team player with ownership: You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally with other teams while taking responsibility for your deals.
• Technical Interest: Curiosity or interest in manufacturing technologies such as CNC machining, additive manufacturing, or injection molding is a major advantage.
• Languages: You are a native-level German speaker, as a significant proportion of our customers are based in the DACH region, and you have very good English skills. Additional language skills are an advantage.

Join Us & Raise the Bar At MakerVerse, we don’t just execute - we innovate. We don’t just meet expectations - we exceed them. If you’re ready to take on responsibility, take on meaningful challenges, and grow as part of a strong team, we look forward to receiving your application.
At MakerVerse, we live by these principles:
• We Own It. We Deliver It. We take responsibility, act with purpose, and go the extra mile to make an impact.
• We Execute Relentlessly. We Solve Big Challenges. We embrace a “doer” mentality and focus on solutions, not problems.
• Our Customers’ Success = Our Success. We make an impact and prioritize what drives our customers’ success.
• We Win Together. We Set the Bar High. We challenge and support one another to give our best and thrive as a high-performing team.

Curious about our employee benefits ? Find more information at www.makerverse.com/careers

About us The future of Digital Manufacturing - Join us today!

MakerVerse is the leading platform for sourcing industrial parts, providing instant access to a vetted supply chain and the full range of manufacturing technologies. With AI-powered quoting, order management, and fulfillment, MakerVerse helps with everything from initial prototypes to full-scale production. jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com﻿

Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will lead and execute clinical Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP) modeling projects within multidisciplinary systems pharmacology, pharmacometrics, and drug development teams, driving model-informed decision making across development programs.
- Additionally, you will develop, qualify, apply, and communicate fit-for-purpose QSP models that integrate non-clinical, translational, biomarker, and clinical data to address critical scientific and development questions.
- You will also translate biological and pharmacological knowledge into quantitative model structures, assumptions, and simulations, generating actionable insights while clearly communicating model limitations, uncertainties, and their potential impact.
- Furthermore, you will define and drive QSP modeling strategies aligned with project objectives, delivering scientifically robust analyses and interpretations to support clinical development decisions.
- You will provide independent advice on complex mechanistic modeling challenges and represent QSP expertise in cross-functional scientific, technical, and strategic discussions.
- Beyond this, you will provide scientific leadership and guidance throughout model development, qualification, application, and communication activities while fostering collaboration across internal teams and external partners.
- Finally, you will drive innovation, standardization, and digitalization in mechanistic modeling and simulation by evaluating, developing, and implementing novel methodologies, tools, and technologies, while overseeing external modeling activities to ensure scientific excellence and strategic alignment.

Requirements

- PhD or equivalent advanced degree in systems pharmacology, pharmacometrics, clinical pharmacology, computational biology, bioengineering, mathematics, or a related quantitative field
- Several years of hands-on professional experience in QSP modeling in the pharmaceutical industry, regulatory authorities, or relevant academic research
- In-depth knowledge of mechanistic modeling in clinical drug development, including model development, calibration, qualification, simulation, sensitivity analysis, and interpretation of results
- Experience with R and/or relevant QSP modeling platforms such as MATLAB/SimBiology, Julia, OSP Suite, or comparable tools; experience with statistical methods for analysis of nonclinical and clinical data is beneficial
- Strong ability to communicate complex modeling concepts, assumptions, uncertainties, and decision impact clearly to multidisciplinary audiences
- Proven collaboration skills in international, multidisciplinary teams and ability to interact effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including experts, CROs, vendors, and leadership teams
- Fluent in written and spoken English

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

Working in a highly regulated GMP/GDP environment, you will help ensure that all required documentation is complete, compliant and available for timely batch certification.

This role offers a unique combination of quality assurance, documentation management and cross-functional collaboration, allowing you to work closely with international customers, project teams and internal stakeholders while contributing directly to patient safety and regulatory compliance.

- Preparing, reviewing and compiling documentation required for QP certification and batch release
- Coordinating with customers, Global Project Managers and internal teams to obtain and track quality documentation
- Preparing Certificates of Release, Confirmations of Import and QP Declarations
- Verifying country-specific clinical trial approvals and maintaining release documentation
- Supporting the creation, review and maintenance of SOPs and other quality documents
- Maintaining QP tracking tools, documentation records and compliant archiving practices
- Supporting internal audits, client audits and health authority inspections
- Participating in investigations, CAPA activities and quality system improvements
- Contributing to Permanent Process Improvement (PPI) initiatives and helping optimize QA processes
- You'll work in close collaboration with cross-functional teams and play an important role in ensuring that clinical trial supplies meet the highest quality and regulatory standards before reaching patients around the world.

Education:

- Completed vocational training as PTA, PKA, CTA, Pharmaceutical Assistant or a comparable qualification

Experience:

- Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment
- Previous exposure to documentation management, batch release or clinical supply operations is an advantage

- Structured, detail-oriented and quality-focused approach to work

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with SharePoint, TrackWise or eDMS is beneficial
- Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams

- Outstanding career and development prospects
